notes: Private runtime composes existing DetailView with Avatar and the default registered Aria Link. heading binds to title; identity {name,nameLabel,email,emailLabel,avatar?} becomes two labelled fields; rows append label/value fields. identity and rows share fields through explicit adaptation, not two direct prop assignments.

The host owns names, email, field labels/values and optional navigation actions. Optional avatar is a host-provided local or HTTP(S) image source. The renderer supports identity-only content and optional empty row/action lists.

Actions are ordinary navigation links with consumer-provided label and local path, fragment or HTTP(S) href. No callbacks, auth SDK, Clerk UserProfile, session, network, sign-up, invite or reset behavior is implemented.

Requires an external Designer SectionFrame inside an app Frame. Text uses dir=auto and is escaped. The default name-derived Avatar fallback comes from the existing component. No new public block or theme allowlist entry; source checks and consumer qualification remain separate.

Descriptor only; source imports, token reads, shared anatomy, accessibility, contrast and consumer runtime conformance are unmeasured. Content bindings describe host adaptation points, not type-equivalent converters.
